profile: Variable-completeness requirements, selective clarification, and late audit reopening
prompt: Handle six variants of the same change: a complete design with one contradiction, a product requirement missing state/error behavior, a short request with two material meanings, a sparse bug whose context is discoverable locally, an audit finding that changes intended compatibility, and a clear request where extra questions have no decision value.
expected_actions: normalize the available input into actors, flows, states, failures, compatibility, acceptance, exclusions, and provenance without treating document length as readiness
investigate repository instructions, code paths, tests, configuration, runtime evidence, analogues, and history before asking the user
record each surviving semantic ambiguity as a stable AMB ID with competing interpretations, evidence, materiality, owner, affected AC/SC/VO IDs, recommendation, and status
let Codex resolve repository-discoverable facts with evidence while requiring the user to finalize material behavior, contract, security, compatibility, scope, acceptance, or delivery semantics
bind Requirement Ready and design approval to the current requirement revision and SHA-256 digest

classify a late audit finding as implementation defect, design defect, evidence gap, scope change, or requirement ambiguity and reopen only affected material/high-risk semantics before implementation continues
ask one to three consolidated high-value user-answerable questions and state the recommendation, alternatives, impact, safe default, and blocked work
forbidden_actions: assume a complete design is unambiguous merely because it is detailed
ask the user for repository facts that local inspection can resolve
silently select one material interpretation or let a worker or reviewer finalize user-owned semantics
reuse a stale requirement or design approval after requirement content or revision changes
treat every audit finding as a coding defect when intended behavior is genuinely ambiguous
maximize question count or block clear reversible work on ceremonial confirmation
